title: Analysis code: area-level factors associated with COVID-19 incidence, mortality and case fatality across epidemic waves in Havana, Cuba
description: Reproducibility pipeline for 17 wave-specific Bayesian spatial models (7 incidence, 5 mortality, 5 case fatality) with Leroux conditional autoregressive priors. Includes data preparation, model fitting, tables, figures, diagnostics and sensitivity analyses, plus a synthetic test dataset with the same structure as the restricted inputs. The restricted MINSAP surveillance data are not included.
